name: Ema India Limited
summary: EMA India Ltd. engages in the manufacture of hardening and heating equipment. It designs and manufactures custom-built machine for applications like induction hardening, partial heating, annealing, tempering, softening, brazing, heating for shrink fitting and billet heating. The company was founded by Hari Bhargava and Pradip Kumar Bhargava on May 6, 1971 and is headquartered in Kanpur, India.
